name: Goofy Ahh Land
source:
The game we made is called "Goofy Ahh Land", which tells about Keira who is trapped in Goofy Ahh Land to play various games that threaten her life. However, for every life lost the greater the chance of pocketing $1000000.

[from [url=https://nalskii.itch.io/goofy-ahh-land]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我们制作的游戏叫《Goofy Ahh Land》，讲述了凯拉被困在Goofy Ahh Land玩各种威胁她生命的游戏。然而，每失去一条生命，赚到100万美元的机会就越大。

[来自[url=https://nalskii.itch.io/goofy-ahh-land]itch.io[/url]]
